name: Elizabeth
source:
Elizabeth... General of the Grand Vanguard to the Royal Family, the best known healer in Elysium... and the first woman that I've had strong feelings for. We've known each other for so long that everyone seemed so surprised that we haven't gotten married yet. There's a reason for that, or at least one we both feel is the main reason... my brother, Isaac. There's nothing particularly wrong with him... but Liz is too sweet to tell him about her feelings toward me, and I'm too afraid of telling him that we [i]are[/i] together. So what's the next best solution? Hide our love from him.... This makes us feel horrible, though. We need to tell him eventually... maybe after the Trials. I just hope he'll understand.

[In game description]
